title: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street
raw_excerpt: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei speaks at the Nasdaq ahead of his company’s public debut. | Photo: Michael Nagle / Bloomberg via Getty Images Anthropic has officially gone public. It began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share , up from its initial $83 per share price that put company's value at around $1.5 trillion. The listing comes nearly a month after Anthropic revealed its plans to go public . In its lengthy S-1 filing, the AI company reported recording an $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of this year, most of which comes from an accounting charge that doesn't reflect its business, along with $16.3 billion in revenue. summary: Anthropic 于 11 月 19 日正式登陆纳斯达克，代码 ANT，开盘 111.5 美元，较 83 美元发行价高约 34%，收盘涨 17% 至 97.17 美元，市值约 1.27 万亿美元，募资 813 亿美元，超越 SpaceX 成为史上最大 IPO。S-1 显示上半年净亏损 807 亿美元，主要来自会计计提。这是 AI 基础模型公司首次接受公开市场定价，为后续 OpenAI 等上市立下标杆。

title: Gemini 4 Neon
raw_excerpt: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a fast, frontier-level model for complex coding, knowledge work, and science tasks. It scored 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
summary: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，定位快速前沿模型，面向复杂编程、知识工作与科学任务。Artificial Analysis 智能指数得分 61，定价每百万输入 token 3 美元、输出 15 美元，约为旗舰一半成本。这是 Gemini 4 系列七周内第四款元素命名模型，社区评价其性价比突出，标志谷歌以密集迭代重回一线竞争。

title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
summary: Anthropic 公布 Claude 在黑洞物理领域解决两个开放问题的研究成果，相关推文在 HN 获近 500 分。这是前沿模型在理论物理原创发现上的少见公开案例，Anthropic 同时发布技术说明。若结果经同行验证，将强化「AI 辅助科学发现」的叙事，也为模型能力评估提供新维度。

title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
raw_excerpt: Design changes proposed by OpenAI's models cut the circuit area of key parts of its Jalapeño AI chip by an estimated 10% to 13%. With AMD, the same approach delivered up to 14% improvements on AMD's flagship GPU designs.
summary: OpenAI 称其模型参与自家 Jalapeño AI 芯片设计，提出的修改使关键电路面积缩减约 10%–13%；与 AMD 合作时，同一方法在旗舰 GPU 设计上带来最高 14% 改进。这显示大模型正从写代码延伸到硬件设计空间探索，对芯片研发流程和 AI 基础设施成本结构有实际影响。

title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
raw_excerpt: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web," the company says . Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale. Users will be able to decide which of your apps Gemini can access, and be able to follow along as Gemini works because it has its own background window that shows a live preview in your chat, Google says. The feature is rolling out now in English for users in the US. Gemini is introducing the new feature ahead of Apple l … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google 为 macOS 版 Gemini 应用上线 computer use 能力，可跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步任务，如填表、做演示、发布二手商品。用户可限定可访问应用，Gemini 在独立后台窗口实时预览操作过程。该功能先向美国英语用户推送，是 Gemini 桌面代理化的重要一步。

title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
raw_excerpt: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg , which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. An AI agent from Apple would put the iPhone maker in the running to compete with the likes of Meta's Muse , OpenAI's Dots , Anthropic's Duet , and Google's Tasks . Muse, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can already take control of a computer through their Mac apps, while Google just started letting Gemini do the same. Apple began rolling out it … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 彭博发现苹果招聘启事，正招募工程师主导开发可浏览网页、跨应用操作、写代码和调用服务的 agentic AI 助手。这意味着苹果正式加入 AI 智能体竞赛，对标 Meta Muse、OpenAI Dots、Anthropic Duet 与 Google Tasks。若落地，将把智能体能力带入 iPhone 生态，影响数十亿用户交互方式。

title: Anthropic's compute spending is increasing by 4x per year, outpacing OpenAI's 3x
raw_excerpt: Anthropic spent nearly $10 billion on compute and infrastructure in the third quarter of 2026.
summary: Epoch AI 数据显示，Anthropic 算力与基础设施支出正以每年约 4 倍速度增长，超过 OpenAI 的 3 倍；仅 2026 年第三季度就花费近 100 亿美元。该数据为两家头部实验室的军备竞赛提供量化参照，也解释 Anthropic 为何急于上市融资，是判断 AI 资本开支周期的重要指标。

title: google-research/paper-orchestra
raw_excerpt: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
summary: Google Research 开源 PaperOrchestra，一个用于自动撰写 AI 研究论文的多智能体框架，单日获约 1200 星。它把论文写作拆解为多代理协作流程，反映「AI 做科研」正从实验走向成稿环节。对研究者是提效工具，也引发关于学术产出真实性与署名规范的讨论。

title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
raw_excerpt: ChatGPT can receive  audio prompts from your microphone faster now with a Live Dictation feature that transcribes as you speak, rather than waiting until you finish recording. It's rolling out now globally on all ChatGPT plans on the web, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps. While using dictation in ChatGPT, you can tap or click the audio waveform to show the live text transcript the AI is generating, then edit it in the prompt box when you're done. Dictation in ChatGPT is getting faster and more reliable. With Live Dictation, your speech turns into text as you talk, so you spend less time waiting for your message to finish transcribing. … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 上线 Live Dictation，边说边转写，不再等录音结束，覆盖网页、桌面、iOS 与 Android 全部套餐并全球推送。用户可点音频波形查看实时文本并在输入框编辑。该功能降低语音输入延迟，是 ChatGPT 向日常输入入口渗透的实用改进。

title: SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent
raw_excerpt: The 100 line AI agent that solves GitHub issues or helps you in your command line. Radically simple, no huge configs, no giant monorepo—but scores >74% on SWE-bench verified!
summary: SWE-agent 团队开源 mini-swe-agent，仅约 100 行代码的 AI 智能体即可解决 GitHub issue 或在命令行协助，SWE-bench verified 得分超过 74%，且无需庞大配置与巨型 monorepo。它以极简实现逼近复杂框架效果，对研究智能体最小必要组件和降低复现门槛都有参考价值。
